claims: Keegan Bradley was born on June 7, 1986.
Keegan Bradley is an American professional golfer.
Keegan Bradley won the 2011 PGA Championship in his major debut.
Keegan Bradley was named the 2025 U.S. Ryder Cup captain.
As of April 2026, Keegan Bradley is an active PGA Tour player.
As of April 2026, Keegan Bradley resides in Jupiter, FL.
Keegan Bradley is the nephew of Pat Bradley.
Pat Bradley is an LPGA Hall of Fame member.
Keegan Bradley has been married to Jillian Bradley since 2016.
Keegan Bradley and Jillian Bradley have two sons, Logan and Cooper.
Keegan Bradley won the 2024 BMW Championship.
Keegan Bradley won the 2025 Travelers Championship.
Keegan Bradley frequently features in Netflix's Full Swing.
As of mid-April 2026, Keegan Bradley is competing in the 2026 PGA Tour season.
As of mid-April 2026, Keegan Bradley is competing at the RBC Heritage following the Masters.
Keegan Bradley has earned over $56 million in his career.
